lines.text: The LORD tells His people to come out of Babylon and save their lives from His fierce anger.
The LORD will punish Babylon's idols, and Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel.
Those who escaped the sword are told to depart and remember the LORD and Samaria from far away.
The LORD will silence Babylon's mighty voice, and her warriors will be captured and their arrows broken.
The LORD of Hosts says Babylon's thick walls will be leveled and her high gates consumed by fire.
